lines.say: acts on the ghrelin receptor to prompt growth hormone release
growth hormone secretion roughly doubled in children given a nasal form
IGF-1 didn't rise in nine healthy men taking it alone (small study)
IGF-1 rose in 14 men on testosterone taking it with sermorelin and GHRP-6
appetite and food intake rose in lean and obese adults
cortisol rises, a class effect of ghrelin-type drugs per a review
FDA has reports of higher insulin needs; blood sugar and HbA1c are tracked
FDA cites reports of pancreatitis and infection; causality not established
FDA flags possible immune reactions from aggregation and impurities
FDA cites deaths of critically ill study subjects; causality not established
